name: ROS environment setup
description: Sources ROS distro setup files and optionally a workspace overlay into shell rc files. Safe to use on non-ROS containers — sourcing is conditional.

rosDistro.description: ROS distro to source (e.g. 'humble', 'jazzy'), or 'auto' to detect from /opt/ros

workspaceSetupPath.description: Absolute path to a workspace setup file to source after the distro (e.g. /ws/install/setup.bash)

targetUser.description: User whose shell rc files to modify
